J-2 BREAKS. THIS RUN DOES NOT EARN GOAL-SEMBIN-5078bc COMPLETION CRITERION 1. Landed at fed1b8c21. THE METRIC: the contract's D_macaulay_rank_statistic was never computed. code/run_cells.py binds that contract metric NAME directly to the VALUE closure_D, so the raw records carry D_macaulay_rank_statistic: 4 beside closure_D: 4 -- a name collision that makes the substitution invisible to anyone reading the results table. And closure_D is F4-SIDE BY ITS OWN DEFINITION: closure_cert.py states the equivalence as 'G_D is a Groebner basis iff F4 completes with step degree <= D', so it is the solving degree of a truncated F4. The instrument the same file labels 'the DREG statistic' returns a rank and a deficit at an INPUT degree and returns no degree at all. So the headline closure_D - d_F4 = 0 IS AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO F4-SIDE QUANTITIES, not a map between d_F4 and a Macaulay statistic. Disclosed nowhere: manifest protocol_deviations is empty and the seven report deviations are all about cells and caps, so 'all for cost, none for content' is false as to the metric and false again as to deviation 2, since closure on draw 0 only makes the R-draw arm of HEUR-001's own falsification condition structurally untestable. WHICH CASE IS STRONGER: the prosecution, but not on the ground the attack plan led with. The defence is real and credited -- msolve is an independently written F4 with the opposite field-equation convention, so 9 byte-identical agreements are a genuine falsifiable test of the closure's ARGUED truncated-Buchberger equivalence and it could have failed. What kills it is that the headline and the conclusion are about different objects joined by no measurement, and the input-versus-output point is a property of a function signature the run wrote -- ALREADY COMMITTED IN EV-DREG-008's OWN BOUNDARIES SEVEN WEEKS EARLIER ('Structural deficit_genuine is not theoretical d_reg'). Worse, GOAL-DREG-001's actual campaign quantity is d_reg as an OUTPUT (d_reg(null)=7 at n=12, analytic linear law c*=0.23748, Theta(n)), which this run never touches. FALSIFICATION CRITERION UNSOUND, fault in the CONTRACT not the run: its consequent conflates the degree at which a Macaulay matrix was BUILT with a degree the system ATTAINS -- EV-DREG-008 computes a rank at frozen input D=6, which asserts no degree statistic of 6 and cannot be in tension with d_F4 <= 4. The antecedent is unmet anyway. UNIT-IDEAL COUNT AMONG THE 9: FIVE, four at (15,5,3,3) and one at (17,3,3,6) random B; on those five the closure decides by 1 in W_D and on the other four by standard-monomial match, so TWO DIFFERENT CERTIFICATES ARE REPORTED AS ONE FINDING. Controls: known-false PASS (the argument correctly declines); unsatisfiable instances FAIL (the 5/4 split is never reported, and the run's '35 of 43' is over F4 traces not the 9); matched null PARTIAL FAIL; EV-DREG-008 passes for the named record but fails as a general block. Interpretation limits RESPECTED in both directions, checked hard, no Assumption-1 leakage. THE FIX NEEDS ZERO RUNS: 31 instances already carry both the single-level rank/deficit and a d_F4 value, 3.4x the closure's 9, so naming one of the three readings in H-SEMBIN-112e2e and computing separation_D_minus_d_F4 from committed records produces the metric the contract actually declared. DISCLOSED as PD-RT-1: ran one read-only git status --porcelain to check it had not written outside scope, against a bound saying run no git command; it changed nothing and opened no sibling file.

The two rounds the producer excludes -- and files under the name f4_empty_step_degrees [4, 5] -- SELECTED 34 AND 519 PAIRS and computed row echelon forms of 1915x2220 and 84267x84198 matrices. On sem_n12_m6_t6_k2_low_B_ran_s20260913004_d3 that is 4 (producer) versus 5 (literal). It reaches no separation, because no n=12 cell ever ran the closure. The exclusion the d_F4 definition turns on has nothing to act on here -- which means the producer's new == 0 rule is doing ALL the exclusion work and it is not Semaev's rule. Reported as an engine property plus a coverage limit (the Macaulay block probed only D=3 and D=4), never as evidence against the mechanism. TAIL CHECK (i) depends on the comparison and both are reported: raw 11 of 11 hit, like-for-like at degrees >= 2 ZERO of 11. The raw hit is systematic, because a closure profile always carries degree-1 pivots while an F4 run has no step at degree 0 or 1, so the profiles are indexed on different things and only supports are comparable.
